ProbabilityTheory.entropy.statement:
Let $\Omega$ and $S$ be measurable spaces. For a function $X:\Omega	o S$ and a measure $\mu$ on $\Omega$ (if omitted, $\mu$ is filled in automatically as the default measure $\mathrm{volume}$ of a measure-space structure on $\Omega$), this defines the real number $H[X;\mu]=H_m[X_*\mu]$, the measure entropy of the pushforward measure $
u=X_*\mu$ on $S$, i.e. $H[X;\mu]=\sum_{s\in S}\mathrm{negMulLog} ig(((
u(S))^{-1}\cdot
u)(\{s\}) ig)$, where the measure $(
u(S))^{-1}\cdot
u$ (scalar in $[0,\infty]$) is evaluated on $\{s\}$ as a real number, $\mathrm{negMulLog}(t)=-t\log t$, and the sum is an unconditional (tsum) sum over $S$ (equal to $0$ if not summable). According to the docstring, this is the entropy of a random variable with values in a finite measurable space (finiteness of $S$ is not an assumption of the definition).

ProbabilityTheory.condMutualInfo.statement: Let $\Omega$, $S$, $T$ and $U$ be measurable spaces. For functions $X:\Omega\to S$, $Y:\Omega\to T$, $Z:\Omega\to U$ and a measure $\mu$ on $\Omega$ (if omitted, $\mu$ is filled in automatically as the default measure $\mathrm{volume}$ of a measure-space structure on $\Omega$), this defines the real number $$I[X:Y\mid Z;\mu]=\int_U \Big(H[X\mid Z\leftarrow z;\mu]+H[Y\mid Z\leftarrow z;\mu]-H[\langle X,Y\rangle\mid Z\leftarrow z;\mu]\Big)\,d(Z_*\mu)(z),$$ a Bochner integral with respect to the law $Z_*\mu$ (pushforward of $\mu$ under $Z$) on $U$, where $\langle X,Y\rangle:\Omega\to S\times T$ is $\omega\mapsto(X(\omega),Y(\omega))$ and $H[W\mid Z\leftarrow z;\mu]$ denotes the entropy of $W$ with respect to $\mu$ conditioned on the event $\{Z=z\}$. According to the docstring, this conditional mutual information is the mutual information of $X\mid Z=z$ and $Y\mid Z=z$, integrated over $z$.

ProbabilityTheory.entropy_eq_sum_finset.statement: Let $\Omega$ and $S$ be measurable spaces (arbitrary types with measurable-space structures), let $X:\Omega\to S$ be any function (no measurability assumed), let $\mu$ be a measure on $\Omega$ that is either the zero measure or a probability measure, and let $A$ be a finite subset of $S$ such that the pushforward measure $X_*\mu$ gives measure $0$ to the complement $S\setminus A$. Then $$H[X;\mu]=\sum_{x\in A}\mathrm{negMulLog}\big(X_*\mu(\{x\})\big),$$ where $H[X;\mu]$ is the entropy of $X$ with respect to $\mu$, $\mathrm{negMulLog}(t)=-t\log t$, and $X_*\mu(\{x\})$ is taken as a real number.
